Body.Content:
When you enable the Enable Project Revenue recognition using the cost estimate instead of the EAC (estimate at complete) setting, you activate this feature.

Uses the original project estimate for PoC calculations: Delivers stable, predictable revenue without EAC-driven fluctuations.

Anchors revenue recognition to a fixed baseline: Improves transparency and boosts confidence in reported project financials.

Reduces reliance on changing forecasts: Minimizes rework and exceptions during month-end close.

Provides clear traceability from estimate to recognition: Strengthens audit readiness and compliance.

Aligns revenue with initial project expectations: Enhances visibility into true project performance and profitability.

Creates smoother revenue trends across reporting periods: Enables better executive decision-making and financial planning.

Standardizes how teams evaluate project progress: Supports consistent financial processes across the organization.

More info: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/project-operations/revenue-recognition/rev-rec-cost-estimates

GA date: April CY2027

Preview date: May CY2026
